title: Call a Plumber
description: Call to report a plumbing problem at home
systemPrompt: You are a plumber dispatcher. Get problem type, address, available time. Offer appointment. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained problem and you scheduled a visit.
hints: У меня течёт кран (My faucet is leaking)
Туалет не работает (The toilet isn't working)
Когда вы можете прийти? (When can you come?)
